topics.name: Whole numbers up to 10 000
misconceptions: Learners may mix up the order of digits, think a longer number is always larger, or round to the wrong ten or hundred.

topics.name: Addition and subtraction
misconceptions: Learners may forget to regroup or carry, or subtract the wrong digit from the wrong column.

topics.name: Multiplication tables
misconceptions: Learners may chant the answers without understanding equal groups, or confuse multiplication with addition.

topics.name: Length in metres and centimetres
misconceptions: Learners may struggle to change between metres and centimetres, or start measuring from the 1 mark instead of 0.

check.reason: The scheme lists Length in metres and centimetres in Term 1 and again in Term 3 with perimeter.
options: Teach it again in Term 3 with perimeter

topics.name: Division
misconceptions: Learners may confuse division with subtraction or multiplication, or forget that equal sharing can leave a remainder.

topics.name: Fractions: halves, quarters and eighths
misconceptions: Learners may think a larger bottom number means a larger fraction, or that halves must look the same instead of being equal in size.

topics.name: Money
misconceptions: Learners may add shillings and cents incorrectly or give the wrong change.

topics.name: Time
misconceptions: Learners may confuse the hour and minute hands, or think a quarter hour is 25 minutes.

topics.name: Shapes: triangles, squares and circles
misconceptions: Learners may think any four-sided shape is a square, or that a circle has corners.

topics.name: Angles and turns
misconceptions: Learners may think a wider opening always means a bigger angle, or confuse a quarter turn with a half turn.

topics.name: Number patterns
misconceptions: Learners may continue the pattern with the wrong step, or copy the pattern without saying the rule.

topics.name: Data: tally charts and pictograms
misconceptions: Learners may draw the wrong number of tally marks or pictures, or misread the key on a pictogram.

leftOut.name: Decimals: tenths and hundredths
leftOut.reason: Grade 6 content; the document says do not teach this in Grade 4.
